title: CloudWatch: logs, metrics, alarms, and a useful runbook
outcome: Connect an application symptom to a metric, trace/log identity, alarm, and recovery check.
drawbacks: Signal volume, cardinality, retention, and alert noise need design.
version: AWS SDK for Ruby v3 · service-specific setup · no cloud resources created automatically
cue: Signal → question → safe action → verified recovery.

trace.title: Structured signals
trace.detail: Logs explain individual events. Metrics summarize trends. Traces connect steps across boundaries. CloudWatch provides AWS-native observability capabilities; choose the signals and retention you actually need.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
User reports delay → check success/latency and oldest pending age → inspect correlated logs/trace → identify provider, DB, or consumer boundary → apply safe repair → verify backlog drains and user outcome recovers.

Test the alert path itself. A dashboard nobody watches does not wake an owner during a serious incident.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: High-cardinality metric dimensions can increase cost and reduce usability. An alert without a runbook can become noise. A green process metric can coexist with no business progress.
